purpose: Preserve control-migration questions whose resolution may depend on research/governance semantics without allowing CONTROL_PLANE_MAINTENANCE to self-grant task-publication, Driver, Steward, theorem-review, or Foundation authority. These requests are not scheduler/runtime tasks. An authorized Researcher/Driver/Steward may later publish a real immutable GOVERNANCE task if the request still requires investigation.

requests.question: Can the six V1 task-publication control pointers be migrated to immutable V2 authority without changing any mathematical/research governance semantics carried by research_architecture.json?
required_verification: Enumerate the exact six JSON pointers and their V2 replacements.
Prove or explicitly justify that FREE discovery substrate/anti-anchoring semantics are unchanged.
Prove or explicitly justify that Working Truth activation/falsifier semantics are unchanged.
Prove or explicitly justify that axiom-candidate lifecycle and origin provenance are unchanged.
Prove or explicitly justify that successor-stage, portfolio-balance, and route-closure semantics are unchanged.
Prove or explicitly justify that Foundation backflow, independence/replication, promotion, and theorem-status semantics are unchanged.
Produce an exact field-local proposed diff; no unrelated JSON pointer may change.
forbidden_shortcuts: treating newer control precedence as proof that older mathematical/governance text is semantically irrelevant
changing wording or values outside the six registered pointers while performing the cutover

requests.question: Do the ambiguous dispatch fields denote the subordinate registered/fresh task selector or the top-level recovery-aware live control route?
required_verification: Classify research_role_policy.json /task_publication_authority/dispatch as publication discovery/fresh selector versus live owner/session router.
Classify foundation_steward.json /canonical_dispatch_tool in the context of adjacent scheduling_protocol and legacy_scheduler_config fields.
Cross-check against research_task_publication_contract_v2.json, research_dispatch_contract.json, Foundation backflow selector semantics, and active human protocols.
If a field is selector-scoped, protect tools/research_dispatch.py rather than migrating it.
If a field is live-route scoped, migrate only that exact pointer to research_control_dispatch.py.
forbidden_shortcuts: inferring meaning from the substring canonical_dispatch alone
assuming every tools/research_dispatch.py reference is stale
changing Foundation mathematical conventions or task publication semantics during classification
